name: apitadadopai.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.apitadadopai.com scores 59 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Microsoft Clarity (2 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), and cookies YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on youtube.com, VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA on youtube.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 7 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /carne-desfiada-com-massa/, /overnight-chocolate-proteina/, /bolinhos-maca-aveia/, /bifes-pizza-air-fryer/ and 3 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 138 elements on /, /regresso-as-aulas/, /indice-de-receitas/, for example #more-options-btn > span and .post-192118 > .elementor-post__card > .elementor-post__badge. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 56 elements on /, /indice-de-receitas/, for example .post-192118 > .elementor-post__card > .elementor-post__text > .elementor-post__read-more-wrapper > .elementor-post__rea and .post-192068 > .elementor-post__card >…
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 32 elements on /, /regresso-as-aulas/, /indice-de-receitas/, for example .elementor-element-f0e1dd2.elementor-sticky--active.elementor-section--handles-inside > .elementor-element-46b3380.eleme and .elementor-element-f849466 >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on 18 of 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.
